newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Mines issues cautionary.
newsitem.headline: Rand Mines issues cautionary.

text.p: Rand Mines Ltd said on Thursday that a proposal including an offer for the ordinary shares of the company was still being considered by the directors and that shareholders should exercise caution.
The cautionary announcement came close on the heels of earlier announcements on November 7 and November 14.
On November 14 Rand Mines Ltd said i had fulfilled all the conditions needed to press ahead with its unbundling.

The firm said then that its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange would be transferred to the cash companies sector and warned shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in its shares until a further announcement is made.
